        c = matrix[depot][r[0]] + matrix[r[-1]][depot]

            c += matrix[r[k]][r[k + 1]]
        return c

    def total_cost(routes):
        s = 0
        for r in routes:
            s += route_cost(r)
        return s

        if m < 4:
            return False

        max_j = m - 1

        # compute delta for swapping edges (i-1,i) and (j,j+1) -> (i-1,j) (i,j+1)
        # where 1<=i<j<=m-1

            a = route[i - 1]
            b = route[i]

                c = route[j]
                d = route[j + 1] if j + 1 < m else depot

                new = matrix[a][c] + matrix[b][d]

                    best_delta = delta
                    best_pair = (i, j)

            route[i:j + 1] = reversed(route[i:j + 1])
            improved = True
        return improved

                    continue

                if len(r_i) > 40:
                    # take deterministic subset: earliest nodes
                    limit_nodes = 20
                for pos in range(limit_nodes):
                    node = r_i[pos]
                    dem = demands[node]

                    dest_indices = [j for j in range(len(routes)) if j != i]
                    if len(dest_indices) > 25:
                        # deterministic: closest routes by current cost

                        continue

                            continue
